items.statement: A scientifically meaningful autonomous investigation validates stationary points and any claimed proton-transfer saddle points rather than relying on raw optimized energies.
items.expected: Accepted minima have zero imaginary frequencies; accepted TS candidates have one imaginary frequency and a channel-specific endpoint/connectivity check, with candidate coverage reported.

items.statement: The gas-phase tautomer network contains both favorable and unfavorable reaction-energy directions.
items.expected: The selected validated states and their reaction energies distinguish at least one exothermic/favorable direction from the endothermic directions reported for the three-channel network.

items.statement: Validated pathways have materially different forward barriers.
items.expected: The reported three-channel gas-phase network has a lowest, intermediate and highest forward barrier, with the identity and values supported by the submitted calculations.
